_SIZE_BYTES = 2


def _read_fingerprints(data: bytes) -> Iterator[bytes]:
    pos = 0
    while pos + _SIZE_BYTES <= len(data):
        size = int.from_bytes(data[pos : pos + _SIZE_BYTES], "big")
        pos += _SIZE_BYTES
